claims.statement: Ben Hogan appeared in a sparring exhibition with Tom Allen and was given the popular verdict.
claims.excerpt: peared in a sparring exhibition with Tom Allen

claims.statement: Hogan's backers offered to back him for any amount against Allen, but Allen ignored the challenge.
claims.excerpt: against Allen, but the latter ignored the challenge.

claims.statement: Ben Hogan challenged Tom Allen for a $2,000 side bet and the heavyweight championship of America, and Allen accepted.
claims.excerpt: Hogan hurled a challenge at Tom Allen for a side bet of $2,000

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Ben Hogan were arrested as they were about to board a steamer for the Illinois shore of the Mississippi, and were released only on promising not to fight in Illinois.
claims.excerpt: they were arrested. Oniy upon their promise not to fight in Illinois
places: Illinois shore of the Mississippi River

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Ben Hogan fought at Council Bluffs, Iowa; Hogan claimed a foul, and the referee declared a draw.
claims.excerpt: Allen had all the best of it for three rounds, when Hogan claimed that his adversary had struck a foul biow.

fights.stakes: $2,000 side bet and the heavyweight championship of America
fights.excerpt: Allen had all the best of it for three rounds, when Hogan claimed that his adversary had struck a foul biow.
fights.notes: Stopped after about three rounds when Hogan claimed a foul and Allen's backers broke into the ring. The referee declared a draw and returned the money.

notes: Mostly about Ben Hogan; only Allen-related items are recorded. The place of the exhibition is not legible in the text, and no dates are given.
